blocks.text: Setting up Google Sheets for payroll clerks on Mac

Payroll clerks often juggle multiple browser tabs. You can make your life easier by turning Google Sheets into a standalone app. Open Chrome, go to your sheet, and click the three-dot menu. Select Cast, Save, and Share, then click Install page as app. This creates an icon in your Applications folder and Dock. It keeps your payroll data in its own window, separate from your other research or email tabs.
Essential shortcuts for payroll data entry

Speed matters when you have hundreds of rows to verify. Use ⌘ + ⇧ + H to open Find and Replace. If you need to hide sensitive columns while sharing a sheet, select them and press ⌘ + ⌥ + 0. To hide rows, use ⌘ + ⌥ + 9. Pressing ⌘ + / at any time opens the full list of keyboard shortcuts for your current view.

You might handle massive files with thousands of employee records. Keep your data clean by using filters. Go to Data > Create a filter to toggle views quickly. If you find duplicate entries, use Data > Data cleanup > Remove duplicates. This ensures your tax calculations and wage totals remain accurate. Always check your formulas if you move data between sheets. A broken reference often causes the #REF! error.

blocks.text: Do not sign into multiple Google accounts in the same browser window. This often causes permission errors when you try to open shared payroll sheets. Use a dedicated Chrome profile for work. This keeps your personal bookmarks and history separate from your payroll files. If you encounter a blank page or load error, check your internet connection first. Then try clearing your cache in Chrome settings.
If you get stuck on a complex formula, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur to explain what is happening in your cell. It will answer out loud while you keep your hands on the keyboard.

faq.question: Is there a native Mac app for Google Sheets?
faq.answer: No, Google Sheets is a web-based app. You can create a desktop shortcut in Chrome to make it act like a native app.

faq.question: How do I fix formula errors in my payroll sheet?
faq.answer: Check for missing brackets, broken cell references, or incorrect data types. Press ⌘ + / to see if you are using the correct syntax for your function.

faq.question: How many cells can I use in one sheet?
faq.answer: As of late 2026, the limit is 20 million cells per spreadsheet.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with Google Sheets?
faq.answer: Yes, Lazur works in any browser on your Mac. You can ask it to guide you through complex steps or explain formulas while you work.
